body.zh-Hant: 何塞·古鐵雷斯·格拉1869年9月5日生於蘇克雷，1929年2月3日去世；德國國家圖書館權威檔把他的職業記為國家元首與政治人物，並記他逝於安托法加斯塔。百科條目稱他是玻利維亞的總統（1917至1920年）。
body.en: José Gutiérrez Guerra was born in Sucre on 5 September 1869 and died on 3 February 1929; the German National Library authority record lists his occupations as head of state and politician, and gives Antofagasta as his place of death. The encyclopedia entry describes him as president of Bolivia (1917–1920).

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔記載，他自1917年8月15日至1920年7月12日擔任玻利維亞總統。百科條目稱他是自由黨統治時期（1899至1920年）的最後一位總統，任內以選舉舞弊與政府醜聞著稱。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives him as president of Bolivia from 15 August 1917 to 12 July 1920. The encyclopedia entry calls him the last president of the period of Liberal Party domination (1899–1920), and says his administration was marked by rigged elections and government scandals.

citations.quote: Vom 15.08.1917-12.07.1920 Präsident von Bolivien

heading.zh-Hant: 國家團結內閣與政變倒台
heading.en: National concentration cabinet and the 1920 coup

body.zh-Hant: 古鐵雷斯·格拉起初讓主要反對黨共和黨入閣，組成「國家團結」內閣，企圖避開收復太平洋沿岸失地的民族主義高漲。1919年政黨政治再度惡化，自由黨因是否罰款錫礦大亨帕蒂尼奧而分裂。1920年7月，共和黨發動幾乎不流血的政變推翻政府，結束自由黨二十年的支配。
body.en: Gutiérrez Guerra at first included the main opposition party, the Republicans, in a cabinet of "national concentration", hoping to sidestep a surge of nationalist fervor over recovering the lost Pacific coast. By 1919 party politics had again turned acrimonious, and the Liberal Party split over whether to fine the tin-mine owner Simón Iturri Patiño. In July 1920 the Republican Party organized an almost bloodless coup that toppled the government and ended twenty years of Liberal hegemony.

body.zh-Hant: 什韋拉1873年4月15日生於波希米亞的霍斯蒂瓦日，出身古老的農民世家，父親是大農戶，長年擔任村長，也是農民運動的組織者。他先後就讀布拉格的捷克文中學與波希米亞萊帕的德文中學，並在當地上農業專科學校；經濟知識靠自學得來，父親去世後，自1900年起經營家族田產。
body.en: Švehla was born in Hostivař in Bohemia on 15 April 1873, into an old farming family; his father was a large farmer, long-time mayor of the village and organizer of a peasant movement. He attended the Czech gymnasium in Prague and the German gymnasium in Böhmisch Leipa, and the agricultural school there; he acquired his economic knowledge by self-study and, after his father died, ran the family estate from 1900.

body.zh-Hant: 1893年他開始公共活動，創辦並領導霍斯蒂瓦日的索科爾體操會，擔任體操教師與會長。1900年他在布拉格農民大會上首度以政治人物身分出面，1902年當選捷克農民聯合會副主席，1903年出任其印刷合作社社長。1905年12月他支持引進普遍男子選舉權，並致力把保守的捷克農業黨改造成民主政黨；1907年他在布拉格創辦農民印刷廠與日報《鄉村》。
body.en: In 1893 he began his public activity as founder, gymnastics teacher and head of the Sokol unit in Hostivař. He first emerged politically at the Peasants' Congress in Prague in 1900; in 1902 he was elected deputy chairman of the Association of Czech Farmers and in 1903 president of its printing cooperative. In December 1905 he supported the introduction of universal male suffrage and earned great credit for transforming the conservative Czech Agrarian Party into a democratic party; in 1907 he founded the peasants' printing house in Prague and the daily Venkov.

heading.zh-Hant: 農業黨領袖與戰時政治
heading.en: Agrarian Party leader and wartime politics

body.zh-Hant: 自1908年起，他是波希米亞邦議會議員與捷克農業黨團主席，1908至1909年領導捷克甜菜農對糖廠卡特爾的罷耕。1909年起他出任捷克農業黨主席，成為最有影響力的捷克政治人物之一。1915年他獲聘為由各捷克政黨代表組成的民族委員會秘書；戰爭末期他主持經濟委員會、掌控布拉格穀物機構，並是1918年10月底在布拉格宣布成立捷克斯洛伐克國的四位政治人物之一。
body.en: From 1908 he was a member of the Bohemian Diet and chairman of the Czech agrarian club, and in 1908/09 he led the strike of Czech sugar-beet farmers against the sugar-factory cartel. From 1909 he was chairman of the Czech Agrarian Party, which made him one of the most influential Czech politicians. In 1915 he was appointed secretary of the National Committee formed by representatives of all Czech parties; in the last war years he chaired the Economic Council, controlled the Prague grain institute, and he was one of the four politicians who proclaimed the Czechoslovak state in Prague at the end of October 1918.

body.zh-Hant: 在卡雷爾·克拉馬什領導的戰後第一屆政府中，什韋拉擔任有影響力的內政部長。1922至1929年他出任捷克斯洛伐克總理，僅在1926年3月至10月由一屆官僚內閣短暫中斷；來源稱他的任期是捷克斯洛伐克共和國最成功的。1926年10月他把德意志波希米亞與斯洛伐克天主教派的部長納入政府。他1927年重病，1929年12月被迫辭去所有職務。
body.en: In the first postwar government under Karel Kramář, Švehla became the influential interior minister. From 1922 to 1929 he was prime minister of Czechoslovakia, interrupted only by a short civil-service government from March to October 1926; the source calls his tenure the most successful in the Czechoslovak Republic. In October 1926 he took German-Bohemian and Slovak Catholic ministers into his government. Seriously ill from 1927, he had to resign from all offices in December 1929.

body.en: Švehla died in Hostivař on 12 December 1933; the German National Library authority record likewise gives his dates as 15 April 1873 to 12 December 1933 and describes him as a Czech politician.

body.zh-Hant: 曼努埃爾·普拉多生於1889年4月21日，德國國家圖書館權威檔記他出生地為利馬，職業含政治人物、工程師與銀行家。他是前總統馬里亞諾·伊格納西奧·普拉多之子，來源記他的卒年為1967年。
body.en: Manuel Prado y Ugarteche was born on 21 April 1889; the German National Library authority record gives Lima as his birthplace and lists politician, engineer and banker among his occupations. He was the son of the former president Mariano Ignacio Prado, and the sources record his death in 1967.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔記他1939至1945年為秘魯總統。百科條目稱，第一任期內他完成了前任獨裁者貝納維德斯開始的許多計畫，包括1940年的全國人口普查；他的預算管理促成掃盲運動，興建許多學校並培訓新教師，另設立社會保險制度、新的醫療設施，並把道路延長2,400英里。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives him as president of Peru in 1939–1945. The encyclopedia entry says that during his first term he completed many projects begun under the preceding dictatorship of Oscar Benavides, including the national census of 1940; his budgetary management encouraged a literacy campaign that built many schools and trained new teachers, and he established a social security system, new medical facilities and extended roads by 2,400 miles.

body.zh-Hant: 1956年起他再度出任總統。第二任期內他以汽油與其他石油產品的間接稅籌集公款；為減緩富人的批評，他任命尖銳批評政府的《新聞報》主編佩德羅·貝特蘭為總理，但貝特蘭以石油間接稅補足政府需要的嘗試並未成功。1956年之後阿普拉黨獲合法化，1962年選票計票剛結束，軍官即奪權。
body.en: He became president again from 1956. In his second term he raised new public funds through indirect taxes on gasoline and other oil products. To blunt criticism from the wealthy he appointed Pedro Beltrán, the sharply critical editor of La Prensa, as prime minister, but Beltrán's attempt to meet government needs through indirect taxes on oil products was unsuccessful. APRA was legalized after 1956, and military officers seized control just after the 1962 vote count.
